User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user in the system.

uid.description: The unique ID from Firebase Auth.

photoURL.description: URL to the user's profile picture.

Bookmark.title: Bookmark
Bookmark.description: A saved stock symbol for a user.

userId.description: The user who owns this bookmark.

Article.title: Article
Article.description: Represents a social media post or article.

authorId.description: The UID of the user who created the article.

content.description: The main text body of the article.

isHidden.description: Whether the article is hidden from the main home feed.

Comment.title: Comment
Comment.description: A comment on an article or a reply to another comment.

parentId.description: ID of the parent comment if this is a reply.

replyToId.description: UID of the user being replied to for tagging.

replyToPhone.description: Phone of the user being replied to for tagging display.

replyToName.description: Name of the user being replied to for tagging display.

users/{userId}/bookmarks/{bookmarkId}.description: Stocks bookmarked by a specific user.

articles/{articleId}/comments/{commentId.description: Comments and replies on an article.

articles/{articleId}/likes/{userId}.description: Tracks which users liked the article.

articles/{articleId}/comments/{commentId.description: Tracks which users liked the comment.
